title: The get_file_package() function unconditionally stripped the ":arch" qualifier
description:
The get_file_package() function unconditionally stripped the ":arch" qualifier
from the matched dpkg .list filename. On multiarch systems, a file owned by a
foreign-architecture package then resolved via the bare name to the native-arch
package, which is often not installed, will cause a spurious package not
installed error message (LP: #1784116).

The fix is to only strip the qualifier when it matches the system architecture
and keep it for foreign architectures so the name resolves to the installed
package.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~varranvar/+archive/ubuntu/fix1784116

Test script: 

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
PROBE='
from apport.packaging_impl import impl
from apport.report import Report
r = Report()
r.add_package(impl.get_file_package("/lib/i386-linux-gnu/libnss_nis.so.2.0.0"))
print(r["Package"])
'

lxc launch ubuntu-daily:stonking test >/dev/null
lxc exec test --env PROBE="$PROBE" -- bash -eu <<'EOF'
dpkg --add-architecture i386
apt-get -qq update >/dev/null
apt-get -qq install -y libnss-nis:i386 >/dev/null
echo "Bug Reproduction"
test "$(python3 -c "$PROBE")" = "libnss-nis (not installed)"

add-apt-repository -y ppa:varranvar/fix1784116 >/dev/null 2>&1
apt-get -qq update >/dev/null

echo "Fix"
apt-get -qq install -y apport >/dev/null
python3 -c "$PROBE"
EOF
```

@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+From: Varun Varma <varun.varma@canonical.com>
+Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 12:52:18 -0400
+Subject: apt_dpkg: keep :arch qualifier for foreign-arch packages
+
+The get_file_package() function unconditionally stripped the ":arch" qualifier
+from the matched dpkg .list filename. On multiarch systems, a file owned by a
+foreign-architecture package then resolved via the bare name to the native-arch
+package, which is often not installed, will cause a spurious package not
+installed error message (LP: #1784116).
+
+The fix is to only strip the qualifier when it matches the system architecture
+and keep it for foreign architectures so the name resolves to the installed
+package.
+
+Bug: https://launchpad.net/bugs/1784116
+Forwarded: https://github.com/canonical/apport/pull/649
+---
+ apport/packaging_impl/apt_dpkg.py | 6 +++++-
+ 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
+
+--- a/apport/packaging_impl/apt_dpkg.py
++++ b/apport/packaging_impl/apt_dpkg.py
+@@ -863,7 +863,11 @@
+ 
+         match = self.__fgrep_list_for_path(file, likely_lists, all_lists)
+         if match:
+-            return os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(match))[0].split(":")[0]
++            pkg = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(match))[0]
++            arch = pkg.partition(":")[2]
++            if arch and arch != self.get_system_architecture():
++                return pkg
++            return pkg.split(":")[0]
+ 
+         return None
+
